geology.registration_uncertainty: 100-200 m; USGS reported random offset; no shift applied

crism.interpretation: D2300 spectral parameter only; not mineral concentration or resource detection

themis.interpretation: Published thermal inertia; not temperature, weather, dust or radiation

limitations: CTX imagery remains visual context, not numeric terrain.
CRISM cells without a valid observed value remain nodata/transparent.
Geology retains its source registration uncertainty and qualitative map meaning.
THEMIS is a published derived thermal property at native 100 m source spacing.
